text:
Brayden Point left a Nov 8 game in Winnipeg after under six minutes, missed three games on injured reserve, and came back on Nov 17 with an assist in each of his first two games, both Lightning wins. He has 18 points in 19 games.

The goals are what lag. He has five on 7.5 expected, so our numbers call him due: he keeps getting the looks, and goals tend to follow chances. This is a player who led the playoffs in goals during both Tampa Cup runs, and a 12% shooting percentage is below what we'd expect from him.

His legs are the tell. NHL Edge has him at 100 bursts over 20 mph this season, 99th percentile among forwards, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 67% of his entries last season. Carry-ins led to a scoring chance 25% of the time; dump-ins, 8%.

With Brandon Hagel out, Point's minutes have jumped to about 19:36 a night in the games since. What to watch: whether a bigger role gets the finishing back in line with the playmaking.
